stem: How are Desha in the story “Peace and Quiet” and the speaker in the poem “Maple Street” alike?

options.label: F
options.text: Desha and the speaker both find a place to work on something they enjoy.

options.label: G
options.text: Desha and the speaker both are bothered by other people.

options.label: H
options.text: Desha and the speaker both spend time secretly observing others.

options.label: J
options.text: Desha and the speaker both take advice from someone.
